skill_name: Summarize the writings of J K Rowling
workflow: J.K. Rowling is a world-renowned bestselling English author. She is best known for her 7-book Harry Potter fantasy series, which has sold hundreds of millions of copies globally and has been the basis of 8 blockbuster films. Rowling wrote the series primarily for children and young adults but also has explored other genres, including murder mystery and political satire. Her work has been praised for its inspiring themes that champion values such as bravery, friendship, teamwork, and resilience.
